For QA-SRL and QANom evaluation, we adopt the measures put forward by . The unlabeled argument detection metric (UA) measures how many of the predicted answers are aligned with ground truth answers, based on token overlap. Aligned QAs are then inspected for question equivalence to assess semantic label assignment, comprising the labeled argument detection metric (LA).
